The site is Atelier Velo — Solstice Ti Custom Titanium Gravel Bike Configurator, a interactive-product-configurator web application for Atelier Velo Solstice Ti custom titanium gravel bike configurator and build reservation.

Owner brief: "Atelier Velo hand-builds the Solstice Ti titanium gravel bicycle and needs an interactive workshop configurator with a live bill of materials. Riders should be able to choose their frame geometry, titanium finish, and carbon or dynamo wheelset, add fit and internal routing notes, and save a build reservation that persists on the server across page reloads."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-35/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Atelier Velo — Solstice Ti Custom Titanium Gravel Bike Configurator: the page for Atelier Velo Solstice Ti custom titanium gravel bike configurator and build reservation, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #f5f2eb (av-bg), #ffffff (av-surface), #ebe6dc (av-card), #d6cfc2 (av-border), #c2410c (av-terracotta), #9a3412 (av-bronze), #1c1917 (av-text), #57534e (av-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--av-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a selected component whose price or weight delta is omitted from the build total; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

User journey context: Inspect the Atelier Velo Solstice Ti frame geometry table, finish swatches, and live bill of materials. Select frame size, titanium surface finish, and gravel wheelset, and enter rider fit notes.
